'''Linguists''' specialized in understanding and translating [[Language/Legends|languages]]. Even the most dedicated linguists had difficultly in translating the nuanced idioms of [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'lecki]] due to the fact that [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] utilized their prehensile [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] as part of their language.<ref name="SWS" />
